title: Delete leftover Cloudflare Pages project 'porfirio-dev'
description: UPDATE 2026-10-09: The porfirio.dev custom domain has been detached from the Pages project via API (it was the last blocker). The porfirio.dev DNS record is a pre-existing proxied A record independent of Pages, so deleting the project is now SAFE -- verified: DNS unchanged and all routes 200 after detaching. Remaining step: delete the Pages project in the dashboard (Workers & Pages -> the porfirio-dev entry showing porfirio-dev.pages.dev, Pages '<>' icon -> Settings -> Delete project). CAUTION: do NOT delete the porfirio.dev Worker (lightning icon); deleting a Worker also deletes its GITHUB_TOKEN secret and takes the live site down (happened once on 2026-10-09, required wrangler deploy + wrangler secret put GITHUB_TOKEN to recover).
close_reason: Verified complete: porfirio-dev Pages project deleted in dashboard (API shows only unrelated projects remain); porfirio.dev custom domain detached first; DNS is a pre-existing proxied A record independent of Pages; Worker serves porfirio.dev/* with 200s.
